body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Mirasol showed up its latest display technology for e-reader, a 5.7-inch XGA color screen during Digital Experience event at CES 2010, which delivers beautiful color, fast-paced video and visibility in direct sunlight.
